answer: Each identity must lock 120 POA for 40 epochs and complete five peer-attested jobs before rewards unlock. Locks cannot be reused, so each fake identity needs another 120 POA frozen and its own five jobs, turning a dune of cheap copies into a slow climb. Attesters verify the lock is unspent and check job receipts before paying; an ocean of pooled checks spots fakes, and a grove of independent checkers means no single approver can pass a fleet, so marginal cost rises in capital, time, and work per extra identity.
